action: Lies on a cot, turns his head toward the hull to listen, sits up, rubs his face with both hands, stands.
line: That thump. Pump's still running. Okay. Still running.

action: Walks to the wall manifold, scans four analog gauges left to right.
line: Manifold first. Pressure's holding, scrubber needle is in the green.

action: Continues studying the four gauges, gently taps one glass with a finger, relaxes.
Raises his left wrist, presses the dive watch twice with his right hand, looks down at it, exhales.
line: Watch says fifteen meters, and the nitrogen is climbing like it does every hour. Seventeen hours to decompress when I finally go up. Not today.

action: At the lab bench, lifts a small recorder to his mouth and speaks, counting items off with his free hand.
line: Day one log. Diesel tank, 2000 litres, burning 2 litres an hour. Desalinator makes 20 litres of water a day. Pantry count: 700 meals. Do the math later. Math is for later.

action: Looks up at an announcement, turns toward a wall panel where a red fault lamp blinks, lowers the recorder, walks over.
line: (Station) Hydrophone array, channel three, no signal.

action: Works at the telemetry panel, examines the bus tray and pulls it out with both hands. Red fault lamp remains lit.
line: Channel three. I wrote this firmware. Of course it's channel three.

action: Pushes the bus tray back into place firmly with both hands, then presses the red lamp reset; the lamp turns green.
line: Reseat the bus, clear the fault, don't take it personally.

action: Grips a yellow valve wheel on the intake bulkhead, strains twice, it does not move; steps back and shakes out his hand.
line: Intake bulkhead valve is seized. Zebra mussels, probably. Manual crank, then.

action: Braced with knees bent, hauls the yellow valve wheel hand over hand; it first moves only in stubborn jerks.
line: Come on. Come on. There. It's moving.

action: Keeps cranking the same valve hand over hand; the jerks grow faster and smoother. Natural breath and effort.
line: Slow and steady, nobody's timing me.

action: Walks to the centre of the room, looks up through the acrylic dome, takes half a step back and holds still. Dark human silhouettes drift against pale green light above. No gore, shapes only.
line: Okay. Look up. Just once. ...They're still up there. Hundreds of them, blocking the light. Not coming down. They can't come down.

action: Looks down, walks back to the bench, speaks into the recorder, sets it down, glances up over his shoulder at the dome.
line: End of entry. Lab 04 is stable. Supply boat comes in three weeks. I just have to keep the lights on until then.
